title: Staying with Eutris in Cleveland, 1950
summary: He and Red Allen played Chicago's Brass Rail, then he stayed two months in Cleveland playing the Tijuana Club.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was that the time when came T6 over and played with you? ... He was playing the Brass Rail T7 in Chicago and when he and Red finished there they came to Cleveland. He and Red came to Cleveland and Red went on to New York and Jay stayed there with me.
He stayed there about two months.
I don't think Red was working here then, they weren't doing anything here then, so he played there at the Tijuana Club.
So then from 1945 until 1950 what did you do?
I don't know ... (JCH and HIS SISTER BOTH TALK HERE.)
